minutes.headline: Selectmen approved an ambulance fee abatement and amended the boot-drive fundraiser form, then moved to a pavement workshop.
minutes.summary: The board handled routine business: an ambulance fee abatement request and an amendment to the fundraiser form to bar advertising or coupons at boot drives. The pavement management goal was deferred to an off-air workshop. Committee reports covered the Unitil project at 357 Electric Avenue, the school building committee, capital planning and the school budget. The board also discussed pending town counsel opinion on the ten percent rule and rescheduling the building reuse presentation.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved an ambulance fee abatement after the fire chief found the request complete; the vote was not audible in the captions.
The board amended the fundraiser form to bar advertising or coupons at boot drives; the vote was not audible in the captions.
Pavement management was deferred to a workshop session after regular business.
The board moved the building reuse committee presentation from the 19th to February 2 so the school building committee gets a full hearing on the 19th.
The board will seek a short business meeting before next week's joint meeting on town counsel's opinion on the ten percent rule, then recessed off the air for a workshop.

why_it_matters: The ambulance abatement and the boot-drive form change touch fees residents may be billed and how local fundraising on public roads is run.

A resident noted the building reuse committee held ten meetings over eight months with no minutes filed with the clerk, so the public record of that committee's work is thin while the presentation date moves.
The school budget was presented over target, and capital planning and the ten percent rule opinion bear on what may reach residents as votes and on the tax bill.
watch_next: The building reuse committee presentation, moved to February 2.
Town counsel's opinion on the ten percent rule, and the short business meeting the board plans before next week's joint meeting.
